definitions.explanation: The last day of an event, period, exhibition, sale, or scheduled activity.

examples.japanese: {今日|きょう}が{最終日|さいしゅうび}です。
セールの{最終日|さいしゅうび}に{駆|か}け{込|こ}んだ。
examples.english: I rushed in on the last day of the sale.

examples.japanese: {展覧会|てんらんかい}の{最終日|さいしゅうび}は{大勢|おおぜい}の{来場者|らいじょうしゃ}で{混|こ}み{合|あ}っていた。
examples.english: The exhibition was crowded with many visitors on its final day.

notes:
A straightforward compound of {最終|さいしゅう} (final) and {日|び} (day). Very commonly seen on signs, advertisements, and schedules to indicate when something ends.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {最終日|さいしゅうび}を{迎|むか}える: to reach the final day
- {開催|かいさい}{最終日|さいしゅうび}: last day of an event
- {営業|えいぎょう}{最終日|さいしゅうび}: last day of business

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {最後|さいご}の{日|ひ}: the last day (more conversational)
- {千秋楽|せんしゅうらく}: final day of a performance run (theater, sumo)
- {初日|しょにち}: first day, opening day (opposite)
